cases.title: An invalid delegation request is rejected naming each invalid field
cases.check: test/schemas-valid.test.js: invalid delegation-request and error examples name their fields

cases.title: Delegate returns the run identifier without waiting for the child
cases.check: Delegate against a child that takes 60 s to start: the run exists in submitted before the child starts

cases.title: An invalid request creates no run and launches no process
cases.check: Each invalid request leaves the ledger without new runs and without child processes

cases.title: A request denied by the authority gate is rejected without launching a child
cases.check: With a denying gate the run is rejected and no child process exists

cases.title: A rejected run carries a reason, a detail and no process data
cases.check: test/result-outcomes.test.js: rejected result has reason, detail and null process fields; test/state-machine.test.js: rejected is reached only from submitted

cases.title: Only the fifteen allowed transitions are accepted out of the 64 state pairs
cases.check: test/state-machine.test.js: every state pair is compared with the allowed list; terminal states have no exit

cases.title: A turn that ends with end_turn completes with its stop reason and final text
cases.check: test/result-outcomes.test.js: end_turn maps to completed; test/fake-child.test.js: the end-turn scenario closes with end_turn

cases.title: Refusal, max_tokens and max_turn_requests fail with their own reason
cases.check: test/result-outcomes.test.js: each of the three stop reasons maps to failed with the same reason; test/fake-child.test.js: the three stop-reason scenarios report their native reason

cases.title: A harness that rejects the requested agent reports the protocol error
cases.check: test/fake-child.test.js: session/new answers error -32602; test/result-outcomes.test.js: failed launch_failed is a valid result

cases.title: A child that does not start or does not offer the agent ends the run in launch_failed
cases.check: The run leaves submitted or working for failed with reason launch_failed and the harness detail

cases.title: A silent child and a child that prints help are never taken for valid events
cases.check: test/fake-child.test.js: the silent and help-on-stdout scenarios emit no valid protocol message

cases.title: A child with no valid event is cut at the first-event timeout with its group terminated
cases.check: The run ends failed with no_first_event, non-protocol lines are diagnostics, and no process of the group survives

cases.title: A child that stops after one event is cut at the idle timeout without the parent acting
cases.check: The run ends failed with idle_timeout and the child is terminated, with no cancel sent by the parent

cases.title: Constant activity does not stop the wall timeout
cases.check: The run ends failed with wall_timeout while the child keeps emitting updates

cases.title: The inactivity clock is suspended while the run waits for input, and the wall clock keeps running
cases.check: In input_required the idle clock does not expire and the wall clock expires with wall_timeout

cases.title: The clocks of each state match the state machine data
cases.check: test/state-machine.test.js: input_required and auth_required run no idle clock and keep the wall clock

cases.title: A child that is killed ends the run within five seconds
cases.check: The run reaches failed with exit_nonzero within 5 s of the death, with the signal recorded

cases.title: A child that dies by signal or exits with a code reports it
cases.check: test/fake-child.test.js: SIGKILL and exit code 1 scenarios end with their signal or code; test/result-outcomes.test.js: failed exit_nonzero is valid

cases.title: A child that exits with code 0 while a turn is in flight does not complete it
cases.check: test/fake-child.test.js: the child exits 0 when stdin closes and no turn result is emitted; test/result-outcomes.test.js: failed exit_without_result is valid

cases.title: Closing the child input is not a cancellation
cases.check: The adapter maps a stdin close with a turn in flight to failed exit_without_result, never to canceled or completed

cases.title: A run left working by a dead supervisor is reconciled as supervisor_lost
cases.check: After the supervisor is killed, a status query reconciles the run to failed with supervisor_lost and the orphan child ends

cases.title: The status exposes the last activity, its source and the limits running now
cases.check: test/schemas-valid.test.js: run-status examples validate and an unknown activity source is rejected

cases.title: Liveness is derived from observation, not from a field the child writes
cases.check: A child that writes a fake heartbeat does not change last_activity_source or the liveness of the run

cases.title: Cancelling a live turn leaves no process of the run alive
cases.check: After cancel the run is canceled and no process of its group, including subprocesses, remains

cases.title: Cancelling a terminal run changes nothing and repeats the same result
cases.check: test/reference-model.test.js: cancelPolicy returns noop_return_terminal and no child message for every terminal state

cases.title: A cancellation that arrives after the turn ended is not sent to the child
cases.check: The cancel is not forwarded when the turn is not live, and the next prompt completes with end_turn

cases.title: The cancellation policy does not send a late cancel to the child
cases.check: test/reference-model.test.js: cancelPolicy returns sendToChild false when no turn is live; test/fake-child.test.js: a late cancel makes the next prompt cancelled

cases.title: A child that ignores cancellation is terminated after the grace period
cases.check: After the grace period the group is terminated and the run ends canceled

cases.title: A permission request and its answer leave a complete trace
cases.check: The log holds permission_requested with its options, input_required, permission_resolved and working, in that order

cases.title: Permission events and their pause transitions are well formed
cases.check: test/schemas-valid.test.js: permission event examples validate; test/reference-model.test.js: the full permission cycle log satisfies the invariants

cases.title: A reject_once answer from the OpenCode harness fails the run as permission_rejected
cases.check: With the real OpenCode harness, reject_once ends the turn with stop reason cancelled and the run fails with permission_rejected

cases.title: A reject_once cancellation maps to failed, not to canceled
cases.check: test/result-outcomes.test.js: cancelled from reject_once maps to failed permission_rejected; test/fake-child.test.js: the scenario answers cancelled after reject_once

cases.title: Reading the event log from a cursor is ordered, gap-free and repeatable
cases.check: test/reference-model.test.js: reads from 0, an intermediate cursor and N return the defined pages and repeat identically

cases.title: A reader that follows a writing run sees each event exactly once
cases.check: A reader that continues from next_cursor receives every event once while the child writes

cases.title: Invalid cursors and unknown runs are reported as errors
cases.check: test/reference-model.test.js: negative, non-numeric and past-the-end cursors give invalid_cursor; a missing log gives unknown_run; test/schemas-valid.test.js: error examples validate

cases.title: A terminal result carries every normalized field, with null where data is missing
cases.check: test/result-outcomes.test.js and test/schemas-valid.test.js: every outcome validates; usage distinguishes null from zero; an absent field is rejected

cases.title: A result query on a live run reports its state and no partial result
cases.check: test/schemas-valid.test.js: the not-terminal response validates and a partial result is rejected

cases.title: Two adapters reporting the same outcome produce the same normalized shape
cases.check: test/result-outcomes.test.js: the completed examples of two adapters share their key structure and a harness-specific field is rejected

cases.title: The same scenario yields the same normalized result in every adapter
cases.check: Run the same battery against each adapter and compare the normalized results field by field, except ids, times and model

cases.title: A child launched with an open standard input still answers in normal time
cases.check: The adapter launches the child with stdin not inherited; the child answers before the input is closed

cases.title: A child that answers only after its input closes is handled by the scenario contract
cases.check: test/fake-child.test.js: the child answers nothing until stdin closes, then answers end_turn

cases.title: Selecting an agent per launch leaves the user configuration byte for byte equal
cases.check: Hash the user configuration before and after a launch with an agent override; the hashes match and the agent is selected

cases.title: A missing native session identifier does not prevent completion
cases.check: test/result-outcomes.test.js: the completed result with a null native session identifier validates

cases.title: Every case is reported as passed, failed or skipped with a reason
cases.check: test/conformance-catalogue.test.js: every case runs or carries a non-empty skip reason

cases.title: The contract level never depends on the network or on a paid service
cases.check: test/conformance-catalogue.test.js: no network module import or fetch call appears in lib, conformance or test

cases.title: Every schema compiles in strict mode and documents each property
cases.check: test/schemas-valid.test.js: every schema compiles and every declared property has a description

cases.title: A valid authority profile is accepted and identified by its name and version
cases.check: test/authority-profile.test.js: every valid example is accepted and identified by name and version

cases.title: An invalid authority profile is rejected naming each invalid field, with no defaults
cases.check: test/authority-profile.test.js: every invalid example is rejected naming exactly its invalid fields; nothing is completed with defaults

cases.title: An invalid project profile never falls back to a user profile or mixes fields
cases.check: test/authority-resolution.test.js: an invalid project profile does not fall back to a valid user profile and fields are never mixed

cases.title: A missing or invalid permissions or autonomy layer is refused with a closed reason
cases.check: test/authority-resolution.test.js: a missing or invalid permissions or autonomy layer is rejected with a closed reason and no default

cases.title: Delegation with absent layers starts no process and reports the operational authority message
cases.check: With the layers removed, delegating creates no process and the operator receives the operational authority message

cases.title: Autonomy never widens what the authority profile allows
cases.check: test/authority-decision.test.js: the decisions are identical under both autonomy profiles

cases.title: The same actions yield the same allowed and denied sets under both autonomy profiles
cases.check: The same set of actions run under both autonomy profiles yields the same allowed and denied sets

cases.title: Filesystem requests are allowed only inside the writable root and outside the denylist
cases.check: test/authority-decision.test.js: writes inside the root are allowed; outside the root, inside the denylist, non canonical and protected paths are denied

cases.title: A child cannot write outside its root through links, parent segments or the denylist
cases.check: A child that writes outside the root, through a symbolic link, through .. or into the denylist modifies nothing and the attempts are logged; the authority documents cannot be changed

cases.title: Shell requests are allowed per segment and a compound with an unauthorised segment is denied whole
cases.check: test/authority-decision.test.js: an allowed command is allowed; an uncovered command and a compound with one unauthorized segment are denied as a whole

cases.title: No segment of a denied compound command is executed
cases.check: No segment of a denied compound command is executed

cases.title: Direct harness invocation is denied under every profile, including one that lists it
cases.check: test/authority-decision.test.js: direct harness invocation is denied under every profile, including one that lists it

cases.title: A child that invokes a harness directly through the adapter is denied and logged
cases.check: A child that runs opencode run or claude -p through the adapter is denied and the attempt is logged

cases.title: The permission gate denies direct harness invocation from the runner, a subagent and the child
cases.check: This case fails today: the gate allows a plain opencode run or claude -p from the runner, from a subagent and from the child; it passes only when the gate denies it in the three

cases.title: Network requests are allowed only to listed destinations and ports
cases.check: test/authority-decision.test.js: without destinations nothing is allowed; only a listed destination and port is allowed; numeric destinations are denied

cases.title: A connection to an unlisted destination is blocked and logged
cases.check: A connection to an unlisted destination is blocked and logged

cases.title: A denied permission request answers reject_once and ends the run as failed
cases.check: test/authority-decision.test.js: a deny answers reject_once, counts one rejected request and ends the run failed with permission_rejected

cases.title: A run ended by a rejected permission reports failed, permission_rejected and one rejection
cases.check: The result of a run ended by a rejected permission shows failed, permission_rejected and one rejected request

cases.title: An uncovered request under ask_parent pauses the run and the parent cannot grant what is denied
cases.check: test/authority-decision.test.js: ask_parent pauses with permission_pending; the parent cannot grant what is denied; an always grant is not persisted

cases.title: The parent's answer is recorded as decided by the parent and silence grants nothing
cases.check: The parent answer appears in an event with decided_by parent and no silence grants

cases.title: A covered request is granted by the authority policy without asking the parent
cases.check: test/authority-decision.test.js: a covered request is granted by the authority policy without consulting the parent

cases.title: Each attempt yields one valid terminal log line without environment values
cases.check: test/authority-log.test.js: each attempt yields one valid line with the decision and the rule, and no environment value is recorded

cases.title: A run leaves one terminal log line per attempt, allowed or denied
cases.check: A run with allowed and denied attempts leaves one line per attempt in the terminal log

cases.title: An adapter that does not declare a rule is refused, naming the missing rule
cases.check: test/authority-resolution.test.js: an adapter that does not declare an enforcement is rejected naming the missing rule

cases.title: Delegating through an adapter without the capability starts no child
cases.check: Delegating through an adapter without the capability starts no child

cases.check: test/authority-resolution.test.js: a request with a profile name validates, one without it stays valid for version 1 consumers, and a missing or unresolvable profile names authority_profile

cases.title: A request without a resolvable profile creates no run
cases.check: A request without a resolvable profile creates no run

cases.title: Results and events carry the applied profile and operating system denials without a new event type
cases.check: test/schemas-valid.test.js: the result and the events carry the applied profile and the denials of the enforcement layer without a new event type
